thread:
maya: quick heads-up before handoff — the nightly batch job (model-export) is still noisy at scale. we had 18 alerts last night, mostly transient timeouts. planning a small routing/threshold tweak for the handoff window (20:00-02:00 PDT) to avoid waking up ppl for known noise.

leo: ack. do we want to squelch or route to eng-sre-monitoring?

maya: thinking temporary reroute to eng-sre-monitoring + raise threshold for batch_job_timeout from 5%->15% for the window. keep pageable for >30m sustained failures.

priya: sounds reasonable. can we add a short message in the channel header so folks know it's expected? also add a runbook link in the reroute message.

maya: yes — will add header and runbook. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-export (short note: check worker pool memory and S3 latency).

leo: quick config snippet i tested locally for alertmanager routing:```yaml
route:
  receiver: "eng-sre-monitoring"
  routes:
    - match:
        alertname: "BatchJobTimeout"
      continue: false
      receiver: "eng-sre-monitoring"
      repeat_interval: 1h
```
This plus a threshold change in the metrics alert should cut the flapping.

maya: thanks — i'll push the routing change as a dry-run first (add temporary label reroute=night-noise) and update Thresholds in PagerDuty: batch_job_timeout: 15% / page after 30m sustained.

sre-bot: AUTOMATION: created PR #482 for alertmanager routing change (reroute=night-noise). link: https://git.internal/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/482

david: quick question — who covers fallback if reroute fails during the window?

maya: priya will be primary oncall for 20:00-02:00, david is backup. i'll be reachable by DMs and will monitor the dry-run. if pager spikes unexpectedly, we'll revert within 10m.

priya: got it. i'll watch the channel and confirm header + runbook pinned after change. also will leave a short note in the handoff doc.

leo: one more: can we enable short-term suppression for the metric emitter from exporter-3? that instance had ~40% of the timeouts last night. if we can cordon it for the window that's even better.

maya: i'll coordinate with infra to cordon exporter-3 for the window; if they can't, we'll rely on routing.

priya: thanks maya/leo. i'll post a one-line handoff at 19:50 with the exact commands and the PD escalation path. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — leaving this here for handoff notes. tagging @david for visibility.

david: noted. i'll be near my phone but prefer to escalate to priya first.

maya: final checklist (for handoff):
- routing PR merged as dry-run -> monitor 15m
- threshold updated to 15% with 30m sustained page
- channel header updated + runbook pinned
- exporter-3 cordon requested
- priya primary, david backup, maya monitor

priya: checklist looks good. will confirm when all done. :white_check_mark:
